description: This file contains backend unit tests for database-backed asset management system, focusing on validation and integrity constraints such as unique permit IDs, attribute mappings, and hierarchy relationships.

classes.name: DbBackedUniquenessAndHierarchyIntegrityTests
classes.description: Contains integration tests verifying asset uniqueness, attribute mapping, and hierarchy integrity constraints.

methods.name: Create_asset_with_duplicate_permit_eu_id_returns_409
methods.description: Tests that creating an asset with a duplicate permit EU ID returns HTTP 409 conflict.

methods.name: Update_asset_to_duplicate_permit_eu_id_returns_409
methods.description: Tests that updating an asset to have a permit EU ID that already exists results in HTTP 409 conflict.

methods.name: Reporting_attribute_mapping_duplicate_combination_for_same_asset_returns_400
methods.description: Verifies that duplicate reporting attribute mappings for the same asset return HTTP 400 bad request.

methods.name: Hierarchy_integrity_rejects_self_parent_and_cycles_400
methods.description: Ensures attempts to set an asset as its own parent or create cyclic hierarchies are rejected with HTTP 400.
